Sets the volume of audible living players while Alive Louder / Dead Quieter is held. 100% is normal; 0% mutes that group.
Sets the volume of audible dead players while Alive Louder / Dead Quieter is held. 100% is normal; 0% mutes that group.
Lets Perfect Comms shortcuts run while Among Us chat is open. Printable shortcuts can both trigger their action and type into the message.

Sets the volume of audible living players while Alive Quieter / Dead Louder is held. 100% is normal; 0% mutes that group.
Sets the volume of audible dead players while Alive Quieter / Dead Louder is held. 100% is normal; 0% mutes that group.
Hides the in-game speaking bar completely.
Hides the microphone, speaker, and mobile radio controls while keeping their keybinds active.
Cancel echo/feedback of incoming voice picked up by your microphone.
Adjusts the overall volume of all Perfect Comms voice audio you hear.
Spreads natural meeting and end-game voices across the stereo field. Radio remains centered.
Shows a coloured glow around a player's meeting card while they are speaking, subject to concealment and blindness privacy rules.
Chooses whether your mic transmits automatically when you speak or only while Push To Talk is held.
Controls how easily your mic detects speech. Higher values pick up quieter speech; lower values ignore more room noise.
Adjusts how loudly your microphone is sent to other players. This does not change when the mic counts as speaking.
Selects the recording device Perfect Comms uses. Default follows the system's default input device.
Optionally gates residual room noise between phrases. Leave this off to preserve the quietest speech, breaths, and word endings.
Use WebRTC noise suppression on outgoing microphone audio while preserving quiet speech.
Changes the size of the voice HUD buttons.
Temporarily show a 15-player fake roster in the speaking bar for layout testing. It resets off on every game launch.
Shows a small persistent HUD reminder while the microphone is muted or voice playback is deafened.
Shows voice connection progress in the lobby and active retry failures in other phases.
Selects the playback device Perfect Comms uses for voice audio. Default follows the system's default output device.
Chooses whether speaking-bar avatars face left or right while manual layout is enabled.
Show a translucent dark backdrop behind the speaking bar.
Keeps a stable speaking-bar slot for every connected player, including across meeting transitions, instead of showing only current speakers.

Temporarily moves the local settings panel aside and shows an isolated, realistic 15-player live preview of the speaking bar. It turns off when the panel closes, when you leave the HUD tab, and on every game launch.
Use the sliders and layout below instead of the position preset.
Where the player name sits relative to its speaking-bar icon. Auto keeps names inside the screen based on the bar position.
Chooses the speaking bar's screen preset while manual layout is disabled.
Changes the size of the speaking bar, including its player icons and names. In v4, 100% is the same rendered size as 90% in earlier versions.
Chooses whether left/right speaking-bar presets use one vertical lane or wrap into additional columns. Top Middle and Bottom Middle always wrap.
Speaking bar horizontal position (0 = left, 1 = right).
Speaking bar vertical position (0 = bottom, 1 = top).
Starts each voice session deafened: voice playback is muted and microphone transmission is paused until you undeafen.
Starts each voice session with your microphone muted.
Use stronger WebRTC noise suppression. This can remove more background noise but may make quiet speech sound less natural.
Arranges the Perfect Comms HUD controls vertically or horizontally.

How gently voices fade near the edge of vision/range. 0% keeps the original fade; higher keeps voices clear across most of your vision and fades only near the edge. Layers on top of the host's falloff and never extends hearing range.
Lets a player using security cameras hear nearby voice around the active camera position.

Chooses how voice volume fades as a player approaches the maximum hearing distance.
Lets dead players hear one another across the entire map instead of using proximity distance.
Gives the player who called the meeting an exclusive voice floor for a short time when the meeting begins.
Sets how many seconds the meeting-floor grace period lasts after a meeting is called.
Allows nearby players to hear an impostor who is currently inside a vent.
Allows living impostors to hear dead players when the other ghost voice rules permit them to speak.

Lets dead impostors talk back to living impostors in task-phase impostor chat and impostor team radio. Crew ghosts and spectators remain listen-only. The In Meetings child option also allows radio-held private chat during meetings.
Impostors Talk Across Death in Meetings

While Impostors Talk Across Death is on, living and dead actual impostors can hold the radio key to speak privately during meetings, not exile. Living actual impostors, all ghosts and spectators listen; living crew are excluded. Crew ghosts and spectators cannot transmit. Works independently of Team Radio and Meeting Only - Impostor Chat; other mute and meeting-floor rules still apply.
Sets the maximum task-phase distance at which nearby players can hear one another.

During tasks, living actual impostors can speak globally. All ghosts and spectators can listen; dead impostors can speak only with Impostors Talk Across Death. Living crew and other role voice privileges do not gain access. Normal meeting rules apply unless Impostors Talk Across Death in Meetings enables radio-held chat.
Chooses how walls and lost line of sight affect nearby voice audio during tasks.
You must be the lobby host to change these options.
Restricts task-phase voice communication to dead players only.
Restricts normal task-phase voice to players inside the listener's current vision range.
Applies Meetings/Lobby Only to dead players as well as living players.
Disables living-player voice during tasks so normal voice is available only in lobbies and meetings.
Publishes this voice-enabled lobby to the Perfect Comms live directory so other Perfect Comms players can find it.
Enables private hold-to-talk radio channels for eligible teams and roles.
Enables the private impostor team-radio channel when Team Radio is on.
Allows eligible players to use team radio during meetings.
Team Radio - Usable in Tasks Phase
Allows eligible players to use team radio during normal task gameplay.
Prevents players outside vents from hearing a player who is currently vented, keeping vent speech private.
Lets map walls obstruct voice audio according to the selected Voice Occlusion mode.
